title: LoupixDeck plugin store
description: The curated plugin list. It is the only source of the published versions: LoupixDeck downloads this file and installs from it, without asking any plugin repository what its releases are.

schemaVersion.description: 2 since the list carries release information.

id.description: Stable plugin id; matches the id in the plugin's plugin.json and names its folder.

icon.description: Optional HTTPS URL of a square icon; empty when there is none.

platforms.description: Systems the plugin is offered on. Empty means every platform.

minSdkVersion.description: Informational; whether a release loads is decided by release.sdkVersion.

commandPrefixes.description: Prefixes of the plugin's command names, so a config using them is understood even where the plugin is not installed.

release.description: The published release. Everything needed to detect and install an update is here.

version.description: Plain major.minor.patch; the same value the package's plugin.json carries.

tag.description: GitHub tag of the release, always v<version>.

sdkVersion.description: SDK the release was built against; decides whether a given LoupixDeck can load it.

packages.description: One entry per platform build. Either a single 'any' package, or one/both of windows and linux.

fileName.description: <id>-<version>-<platform>.zip, as produced by the plugin release workflow.

sha256.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 of the package; a download that does not match is refused.
